name: Exterior Trim Repaint Caulking
intent: Assess existing caulk, remove failed joints, re-caulk. Three-task sequence: assess, remove, apply.
doctrine: Repaint caulk is assess-remove-apply (NC is just apply). Assessment at 200 LF/hr walk rate. Failed caulk removal at 50 LF/hr (slow detail work). Re-caulk at 75 LF/hr. Condition modifier applies — poor condition means more failed joints.
